chapter_name: Short Composition: Notice, Message, and Diary
learning_objective: 🎯 Master the art of writing quick, clear, and perfectly formatted short notes, messages, and personal diary entries!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Whenever you write a Notice or a Message, it must always, always be drawn neatly inside a rectangular box! It keeps your writing looking professional, tidy, and important.
A Notice is a formal announcement for a large group of people. It must be short and include the 5 Ws: What is happening, When it is, Where it is, Who can join, and Whom to contact!
A Message is a short, informal note you leave for someone when you cannot speak to them face-to-face. Just include the date, time, who it is for, the main info, and your name at the bottom.

A Diary Entry is totally personal! You start with 'Dear Diary' and write down your true feelings, secrets, and the best or worst things that happened to you that day, just like talking to a best friend.

fun_activity.title: 📓 The Best Day Diary
fun_activity.instructions: Grab a notebook, write today's date and time at the top left, and write a lovely three-sentence diary entry starting with Dear Diary about the most fun thing you did today!

quick_recap: ⭐ Notices and Messages are always written inside a neat box and must be short and to the point.
⭐ A diary entry is an informal, personal piece of writing where you share your own feelings and experiences.
